title: Proxmox per-pool VM overrides
description: Schema for proxmox/<pool>.yaml — per-pool VM shape overrides, in the selected template directory (the shape) and in the environment (the instance). The same surface is accepted per CLASS under providers/proxmox/classes.yaml classes.<class>.vm. Resolution order (later wins, maps deep-merge): params.yaml infra.vm_defaults -> class vm -> template proxmox/<pool>.yaml -> environment proxmox/<pool>.yaml. The filename is the binding: it must name a pool (check-bindings.sh + a plan-time precondition — an orphaned name fails, it never no-ops). proxmox/proxmox.yaml is the env-wide provider sidecar (proxmox-env.schema.json) and is not a pool file. Tuning values enter from measured need only.

cpu_type.description: QEMU CPU model for this pool's VMs (e.g. host, x86-64-v3). Default from infra.vm_defaults.cpu_type.

balloon.description: Minimum ballooned memory in MB (Proxmox 'floating' memory). 0 disables ballooning; unset keeps the provider default (no ballooning).

disk.description: Disk knobs applied to every disk of the pool's VMs.

ssd.description: Present disks as SSDs to the guest.

discard.description: Pass discard/TRIM through to the storage. Default from infra.vm_defaults.disk.discard.

format.description: Disk image format. Default from infra.vm_defaults.disk.format.
